name: Real-time transfer function evaluation
aliases: Texture-based volume rendering with GPU illumination
definition: A technique that evaluates and modifies the transfer function in real-time using 2D textures, storing pre-evaluated results for input value ranges to classify voxels and obtain color/opacity.
summary: Real-time transfer function evaluation uses GPU fragment programs to perform dynamic lighting and voxel classification instantly, distinguishing itself from CPU-based approaches by enabling interactive lighting changes.
